description: T-556 SPIKE, not a product plugin. gr-lora_sdr (EPFL, GPL-3.0) RX chain in GNU Radio 3.10's own Python, behind hk_gr_lora.py: hackriff-v1 cf32_le in (no conversion), NDJSON decode lines out, sample_index re-stamped from host indices via a 2-file patch to the OOT. ready once tb.start() returns (0.28-0.8 s warm; 10.8 s first run after a rebuild, before macOS has verified the fresh dylibs - see README).
